CREATE TABLE "public"."bug_approval" (
  "bugReportId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "comment" text,
  "decidedAt" timestamptz,
  "decidedById" text,
  "fixAttemptId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "rejectionReason" text,
  "snapshot" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "submittedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "submittedById" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "bug_approval_decision_valid_7533cc14" CHECK (("status" = 'pending' AND "decidedById" IS NULL AND "decidedAt" IS NULL AND "rejectionReason" IS NULL) OR ("status" = 'approved' AND "decidedById" IS NOT NULL AND "decidedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "rejectionReason" IS NULL) OR ("status" = 'rejected' AND "decidedById" IS NOT NULL AND "decidedAt" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("rejectionReason")) > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT "bug_approval_status_check_19a2b525" CHECK ("status" IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."bug_evidence" (
  "bugReportId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "caption" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "externalUrl" text,
  "fileAssetId" uuid,
  "fixAttemptId" uuid,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "kind" text NOT NULL,
  "uploadedById" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "bug_evidence_kind_check_7fe3d18b" CHECK ("kind" IN ('other', 'before', 'after')),
  CONSTRAINT "bug_evidence_source_xor_ad21740a" CHECK (("fileAssetId" IS NOT NULL AND "externalUrl" IS NULL) OR ("fileAssetId" IS NULL AND "externalUrl" IS NOT NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "bug_evidence_url_https_e620534a" CHECK ("externalUrl" IS NULL OR "externalUrl" ~ '^https://[^[:space:]]+$')
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."bug_fix_attempt" (
  "affectedVersion" text,
  "authorId" text NOT NULL,
  "bugReportId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "commitUrl" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "fixSummary" text NOT NULL,
  "fixedVersion" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "pullRequestUrl" text,
  "rootCause" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "verificationNotes" text,
  "verificationOutcome" text,
  "verificationSteps" text[] NOT NULL,
  "verifiedAt" timestamptz,
  "verifiedById" text,
  "version" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "bug_fix_attempt_verificationOutcome_check_67654efb" CHECK ("verificationOutcome" IN ('passed', 'failed')),
  CONSTRAINT "bug_fix_attempt_verificationSteps_elem_not_null_34f1ffc0" CHECK (array_position("verificationSteps", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "bug_fix_attempt_version_positive_efca705d" CHECK ("version" > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."bug_relation" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" text NOT NULL,
  "fromBugReportId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "toBugReportId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "bug_relation_not_self_e3ab3b8c" CHECK ("fromBugReportId" <> "toBugReportId"),
  CONSTRAINT "bug_relation_type_check_f6e3255b" CHECK ("type" IN ('recurrence', 'duplicate'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."bug_release" (
  "approvalId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "bugReportId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "checkedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "environment" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "postReleaseCheckNotes" text,
  "postReleaseCheckPassed" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "releasedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "releasedById" text NOT NULL,
  "version" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "bug_release_check_valid_23d52e8f" CHECK (("postReleaseCheckPassed" = false AND "checkedAt" IS NULL) OR ("postReleaseCheckPassed" = true AND "checkedAt" IS NOT NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "bug_release_environment_check_d2a5394b" CHECK ("environment" IN ('production', 'staging', 'development', 'test', 'other'))
)
